contact_sources.quote:
Pablo Costella Pinto - Head of LatAm Fixed Income
Description: Pablo Costella is Head of LatAm Fixed Income in Santander Asset Management. With more than fifteen years of investment experience, Pablo is recognised as a leader in the management of fixed income funds and mandates in dollars, currently having assets under management of more than 800 million dollars. Previously within BICE, he was Director of BICE Inversiones SICAV and Global Head of Fixed Income at BICE Inversiones Asset Management and also president of the BICE Inversiones SICAV [...] ## Experience
- Head of LatAm Fixed Income at Santander Asset Management (Apr 2024 to present)
- Head of Global Fixed Income at BICE Inversiones (Jan 2018 to Mar 2024)
- Head of Buyside Research at BICECORP (Mar 2017 to Feb 2018)
- Deputy of Buyside Research at BICECORP (Oct 2014 to Mar 2017)
- Senior Buyside Analyst (Equities + Fixed Income)
